title: Primitive table
description: One group of a scheme's primitives: each primitive's value, drawn, and every token that uses it. Drawn by the PrimitiveTable composite on the Primitives pages.

rows.description: Every primitive of the group, in the scheme's order.

primitive.description: The primitive's path, such as space.4.

value.description: Its value as written, with pixels when it is a length, such as 0.25rem (4px).

sample.description: How the value is drawn, when it can be.

kind.description: What the value is, which sets how it is drawn.

note.description: A line height in pixels, shown beside a leading drawing.

usedBy.description: Every token that points at it. Empty when it is not used yet.

where.description: Where the token lives: semantic, component key, or a theme and mode.
